turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I came straight from the office, Hale, and I have a call at 4:40. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided on that zero, and when?
Be honest. On a scale of one to ten, how am I doing in this meeting?
I'm not grading you, Hale. You haven't answered me. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
And what's one thing I could do better?
You want me to tell you how to do your job? Withdraw the zero and put it in writing. Otherwise I'm walking down to the principal's office when we're done.
